status in (\"submitted\", \"published\"):\n        assert post(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/submit\"\n                    ).status_code == 303\n    if status == \"published\":\n        assert post(client_as(\"admin\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/publish\"\n                    ).status_code == 303\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"status\"] == status\n    return recap_id, trip_id\n\n\ndef action_forms(html):\n    \"\"\"{form action: form html} for every <form> on the page.\"\"\"\n    return {m.group(1): m.group(0) for m in re.finditer(\n        r'<form[^>]*action=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*>.*?</form>', html, re.S)}\n\n\ndef preview_region(html):\n    match = re.search(r'<section id=\"preview\">(.*?)</section>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"page has no <section id=\\\"preview\\\">\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n# ---- the status machine: allowed transitions ------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"actor,start,action,end\", [\n    (\"editor\", \"draft\", \"submit\", \"submitted\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"send-back\", \"draft\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"publish\", \"published\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"publish\", \"published\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"unpublish\", \"draft\"),\n])\ndef test_allowed_transitions_move_the_status(client_as, actor, start, action,\n                                              end):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as, start)\n    r = post(client_as(actor), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/{action}\")\n    assert r.status_code == 303\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"status\"] == end\n\n\n# ---- the status machine: transitions not in the table ---------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"actor,start,action\", [\n    (\"editor\", \"submitted\", \"submit\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"published\", \"submit\"),\n    # Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it; the table has no Admin row.\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"submit\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"submit\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"submit\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"send-back\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"send-back\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"publish\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"unpublish\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"unpublish\"),\n])\ndef test_transitions_not_in_the_table_are_refused(client_as, actor, start,\n                                                  action):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as, start)\n    before = tuple(recap_row(recap_id))\n    r = post(client_as(actor), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/{action}\")\n    assert r.status_code in REFUSED\n    assert tuple(recap_row(recap_id)) == before\n\n\n# ---- who may do what ------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"start,action\", [\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\"),\n    (\"submitted\", \"publish\"),\n    (\"submitted\", \"send-back\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\"),\n])\ndef test_an_editor_cannot_publish_unpublish_or_send_back(client_as, start,\n                                                         action):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as, start)\n    before = tuple(recap_row(recap_id))\n    r = post(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/{action}\")\n    assert r.status_code in REFUSED\n    assert tuple(recap_row(recap_id)) == before\n\n\ndef test_an_editor_cannot_submit_another_persons_recap(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    trip_id = make_trip(admin)\n    admins_entry = make_recap(admin, trip_id)\n    editors = make_recap(client_as(\"editor\"), trip_id, title=\"Mine\", slug=\"mine\")\n\n    other = second_editor()\n    for recap_id in (admins_entry, editors):\n        before = tuple(recap_row(recap_id))\n        assert post(other, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/submit\").status_code == 403\n        assert tuple(recap_row(recap_id)) == before\n    assert post(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{admins_entry}/submit\"\n                ).status_code == 403\n    assert recap_row(admins_entry)[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status\", [\"submitted\", \"published\"])\ndef test_an_editor_cannot_edit_or_delete_their_recap_once_it_is_locked(\n        client_as, status):\n    recap_id, trip_id = editors_recap(client_as, status)\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    before = tuple(recap_row(recap_id))\n\n    assert post(editor, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}\",\n                **recap_form(trip_id, title=\"Sneaky\", body=\"Sneaky edit.\")\n                ).status_code == 403\n    assert post(editor, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/delete\").status_code == 403\n    assert tuple(recap_row(recap_id)) == before\n\n\ndef test_sending_back_gives_the_editor_their_recap_again(client_as):\n    recap_id, trip_id = editors_recap(client_as, \"submitted\")\n    post(client_as(\"admin\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/send-back\")\n    r = post(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}\",\n             **recap_form(trip_id, body=\"Revised.\"))\n    assert r.status_code == 303\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"body\"] == \"Revised.\"\n\n\n# ---- Submit needs a Body; Publish records a time --------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"body\", [\"\", \"  \\n\\t \"])\ndef test_submitting_with_an_empty_body_is_refused(client_as, body):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as)\n    with db.connect() as conn:  # forms refuse empty Bodies, so set one directly\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET body = ? post(client_as(\"admin\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/publish\")\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"published_at\"]\n\n\n# ---- the \"still live until you Deploy\" notice -----------------------------\n\ndef follow(c, response):\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    return c.get(response.headers[\"location\"])\n\n\ndef test_editing_a_published_recap_shows_the_still_live_notice(client_as):\n    recap_id, trip_id = editors_recap(client_as, \"published\")\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    r = post(admin, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}\",\n             **recap_form(trip_id, body=\"Fixed typo.\",\n                          byline_name=\"Jane Doe\", byline_class_year=\"2027\"))\n    assert LIVE_NOTICE in follow(admin, r).text\n\n\ndef test_unpublishing_shows_the_still_live_notice(client_as):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as, \"published\")\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    r = post(admin, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/unpublish\")\n    assert LIVE_NOTICE in follow(admin, r).text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"start\", [\"draft\", \"submitted\"])\ndef test_editing_a_recap_that_is_not_published_shows_no_notice(client_as, start):\n    recap_id, trip_id = editors_recap(client_as, start)\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    r = post(admin, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}\",\n             **recap_form(trip_id, body=\"Fixed typo.\",\n                          byline_name=\"Jane Doe\", byline_class_year=\"2027\"))\n    assert LIVE_NOTICE not in follow(admin, r).text\n\n\n# ---- the editor shows only the buttons the person may use -----------------\n\ndef action_names(html, recap_id):\n    prefix = f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/\"\n    return assert action_names(page.text, recap_id) == {\"submit\"}\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"start,expected\", [\n    (\"draft\", {\"publish\"}),\n    (\"submitted\", {\"send-back\", \"publish\"}),\n    (\"published\", {\"unpublish\"}),\n])\ndef test_an_admin_sees_only_the_actions_that_apply(client_as, start, expected):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as, start)\n    page = post(client_as(\"admin\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/publish\")\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"published_at\"]\n\n\n# ---- the \"still live until you Deploy\" notice  (\"POST\", \"/admin/accounts/1/password\"),\n    # T03: Trips\n    (\"GET\", \"/admin/trips/new\"),\n    (\"GET\", \"/admin/trips/1\"),\n    (\"POST\", \"/admin/trips\"),\n    (\"POST\",  def attempt(email, password):\n        r = log_in(client, email, password)\n        assert r.status_code == 401\n        return r.text\n\n    wrong_pw = attempt(DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], assert client.get(\"/admin\", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_password_is_stored_as_argon2_and_never_logged(client, caplog):\n    with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG):\n        log_in(client, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], \"wrong-password-xyz\")\n        log_in(client, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"],\n               DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"])\n    with So there are no unit tests for the sanitizer function, and it is only exercised through Preview.\n\n**Why they fail:** the dominant reason is 404, because the routes don't exist yet. The textarea echoes the raw Body, so the tests need a handle to tell them apart.\n- **Refusal codes:** refused transitions may return 400, 403 or 409. The ticket doesn't say which.\n- **Notice delivery:** the \"still live until you Deploy\" notice must appear on the page the redirect lands on, so the implementation needs a flash message.\n- **Published timestamp:** `published_at` must exist as a column on `recap`. The tests read it directly, as T03's tests do. `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` won't alter the existing `cms.db`, so the implementation needs a migration or the dev DB needs recreating.\n- **Sanitizer edge cases:** I added a scheme-relative link (`//evil.example`) and a raw `<div onclick>`. That is the `admin-draft-submit` row in the refused-transitions test. {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"9befb7af-ec4f-43a4-8458-1d6db544bfb9","hash":"13e3b4b89828e08a740d858e38b8209b5abee7459b0071ea52db97ac1d8aa796","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"text","text":"Checking the sanitizer tests against your list:\n\n| Item | Covered now? |\n|---|---|\n| `<script>` tags | Yes |\n| External images | Yes |\n| External links | Yes |\n| `mailto:` removed, text kept | Partly: it never checks the text isn't still wrapped in an `<a>` |\n| `onerror` attributes | No. I only test `onclick` on a `<div>`, and an `<img>` is dropped anyway for its source, so it wouldn't prove the attribute was stripped. |\n| `javascript:` links | No |\n\nI'll add the missing ones and tighten the `mailto:` check."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Jo8NxFiAJcLeubnHwwXv6W","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t04.py","old_string":"def test_preview_does_not_save_the_body(client_as):","new_string":"def test_mailto_becomes_plain_text_not_an_anchor(client_as):\n    recap_id, trip_id = editors_recap(client_as)\n    html = preview_region(preview(client_as(\"editor\"), recap_id, trip_id,\n                                  HOSTILE).text)\n    assert not re.search(r\"<a\\b[^>]*>[^<]*mail me\", html)\n\n\ndef test_preview_strips_event_handler_attributes_such_as_onerror(client_as):\n    body = ('<img src=\"x\" onerror=\"steal()\">\\n\\n'\n            '<p onerror=\"steal()\" onmouseover=\"steal()\">kept paragraph</p>\\n')\n    recap_id, trip_id = editors_recap(client_as)\n    html = preview_region(preview(client_as(\"editor\"), recap_id, trip_id,\n                                  body).text)\n    assert \"onerror\" not in html and \"onmouseover\" not in html\n    assert \"steal\" not in html\n    assert \"kept paragraph\" in html      # AND status IN ({marks})\",\n            (to_status, recap_id, *from_statuses))\n        if cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise TransitionRefused(action)\n'''\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\n\np='app/policy.py'\ns=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace('''    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n}''','''    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.submit\": frozenset({EDITOR}),\n}''')\ns=s.replace('''def can(''','''# Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it (an Admin has no row for this).\nOWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.submit\"})\n\n\ndef can(''')\ns=s.replace('''    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:''','''    if action in OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:''')\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\n\np='app/routes/recaps.py'\ns=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace('''BODY_ERROR = \"The Body cannot be empty.\"''','''BODY_ERROR = \"The Body cannot be empty.\"\nSUBMIT_EMPTY_ERROR = \"A Recap with an empty Body cannot be Submitted.\"\nTRANSITION_ERROR = \"That change is not allowed for a Recap in its current status.\"''')\ns=s.replace('''@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/delete\")''','''def _move(recap_id: int, account: Account, action: str, policy_action: str):\n    \"\"\"Run one status change: the policy decides who, the status machine\n    decides from which status. A refusal is a 403 or a 409 and changes nothing.\"\"\"\n    recap = _allowed_recap(recap_id, account, policy_action)\n    if action == \"submit\" and not recap[\"body\"].strip():\n        raise HTTPException(400, SUBMIT_EMPTY_ERROR)\n    try:\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, action)\n    except recaps.TransitionRefused:\n        raise HTTPException(409, TRANSITION_ERROR)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/recaps\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/submit\")\ndef submit_recap(recap_id: int,\n                 account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\"))):\n    return _move(recap_id, account, \"submit\", \"recaps.submit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/delete\")''')\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\nuv run pytest tests/test_t04.py -q -p no:cacheprovider -k \"editor-draft-submit or editor_cannot_submit_another or editor-submitted-submit or editor-published-submit or admin-draft-submit or empty_body\" 2>&1 | tail -6","description":"Implement submit, run submit tests"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

{"parentUuid":"43c2d8e6-0227-490b-89ad-7152dc473f91","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMMTCrs3k45pNfE7GeTh","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T04 is implemented and the full suite passes: 250 passed, which is the 193 from before plus 57 new. Nothing is committed or pushed. I did not run the `/code-review` step that `CLAUDE.md` requires before a ticket-closing commit.\n\n**Your decisions**\n1. **Admin Submit:** the `admin-draft-submit` refusal row stays. Only the owning Editor can Submit.\n2. **Migration:** `published_at` is in the schema, and `init_db` adds it only if the column is missing. I ran it twice on a copy of `cms.db` with no Recaps in it. The column was added and the second run changed nothing. I didn't test it against a database that already holds Recaps. The real `cms.db` is untouched.\n3. **Sanitizer coverage:** two items were missing: `onerror` and `javascript:` links. I added `onerror` stripping, four `javascript:` variants (markdown, mixed case, raw `<a>`, leading space), and a check that `mailto:` becomes plain text rather than an anchor. All six failed first, with no Preview section. They now pass.\n\n**What I added**\n- **`app/markdown.py` (new):** `render_body`, the one function that turns a Body into HTML. It runs `markdown-it-py`, then `nh3` with an allowlist. Preview calls it, and `cms publish` can call it later. It takes an `image_urls` argument, empty until T06.\n- **`app/flash.py` (new):** the one-shot notice behind \"still live until you Deploy\".\n- **Edits:**\n  - `app/recaps.py`: the status machine. The status is checked inside the UPDATE, so two simultaneous requests can't both move a Recap.\n  - `app/policy.py`: the permission rules for the new actions.\n  - `app/routes/recaps.py`: the four action routes and two Preview routes, plus the editor buttons.\n  - `app/db.py`, `app/templating.py`, and two templates.\n\n**Checked by hand:** a direct call to `render_body` kept bold, a relative link and an own-image source. It dropped the external link, `mailto:`, scheme-relative link and external image, leaving their text. It also dropped `<script>` and `onerror`.\n\n**Things to know**\n- **Raw HTML:** the spec says \"strips all raw HTML\", but the approved `<p onerror>…` test expects a raw allowed tag's text to survive. I followed the spec's own mechanism, markdown then `nh3`. So a raw `<strong>` in a Body still renders as formatting, and disallowed tags are removed with their text kept, except `<script>` and `<style>`, whose contents go.\n- **`javascript:` in Markdown:** `[j](javascript:alert(1))` is not a link, so it shows as literal text. Nothing is clickable.\n- **Unpublish:** it clears `published_at`. The ticket doesn't say, so say if you'd rather keep the old value.\n\nSay when you want the code review and the commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":870,"cache_read_input_tokens":119564,"output_tokens":985,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":870,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":985,"cache_read_input_tokens":119564,"cache_creation_input_tokens":870,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":870},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"641917af-dd7b-4b32-b4f4-e400f4d9ab53","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CgMMTC9wjy3P1DCux3bWk","requestRef":"aa452cba-a708-49ad-8da0-b4f511677430","requestedModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"abb4d819-0f17-432a-8886-cc7d6c00b520","timestamp":"2026-10-24T16:10:05.351Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9befb7af-ec4f-43a4-8458-1d6db544bfb9","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

db.init_db()\nprint(\"--- after init_db x2:\")\nwith db.connect() as c:\n    for r in c.execute(\"select id,title,slug,body,status,published_at from recap\"): print(tuple(r))\nrecaps.transition(2, \"publish\")\nwith db.connect() as c:\n    print(\"--- publish #2 on the migrated DB:\", tuple(c.execute(\"select id,status,published_at from recap where id=2\").fetchone()))\nEOF\necho \"--- real cms.db unchanged:\"; {"parentUuid":"9f7694d8-0ccb-49a3-abaf-7971dd14641f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMMqbPYNt87KrK1ASUcH","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Raw HTML in a Body now leaves nothing in the output. The full suite is 250 passed, 0 failed. Nothing is committed or pushed.\n\n**Deviation from your instruction:** I could not keep `html=False`. With it, markdown-it turns `<script>…</script>` into plain text before I can tell it was HTML, which is why the escaped text kept appearing. `app/markdown.py` now parses with `html=True`, then drops every raw-HTML token before rendering. Raw HTML is never rendered and never reaches the page as text, and `nh3` is still the second layer.\n\n**What the removal covers**\n- **Raw blocks:** removed whole, content included. That covers `<script>`, `<p onerror=…>kept</p>` and `<!-- comments -->`.\n- **Inline `<script>` and `<style>`:** removed together with everything between the tags, so `alert(2)` can't leak out as text.\n- **Other inline tags:** a tag such as `<b>raw</b>` loses its tags, and the text between them stays as ordinary text. The output above shows `inline raw and … end`. Say if you want that text dropped too.\n\n**Tests**\n- **The three tests that were failing:** I didn't touch them. They had never been weakened, and they pass again with their original assertions.\n- **The test I renamed:** it is back to its original name, `test_preview_strips_event_handler_attributes_such_as_onerror`, with its original assertions.\n  - **Removed:** the assertions I had added (no `<img`, exactly two `<p>`, and `&lt;img` and `&lt;p onerror` appear as literal text).\n  - **Restored:** `onerror` and `onmouseover` absent, and `steal` absent.\n  - **Changed:** `\"kept paragraph\" in html` is now `\"kept paragraph\" not in html`. The raw `<p>` is removed whole, text included.\n\n**Still rendering** (checked with a direct call to `render_body`): `**bold**`, a relative link, and an own image passed through `image_urls`. {"parentUuid":"4f5c0473-5388-4e49-b9bf-da41021c7cc2","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"2594274e-f76b-4ef6-a270-7780998b9d1f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/andrewv/.claude/skills/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: the uncommitted T04 changes. Focus on: any way to get script, event-handler attributes, javascript: or data: URLs, external links or images through render_body or Preview; CSRF on every new POST route (submit, send-back, publish, unpublish, both Preview routes); access control on each new route (Editors only on their own Drafts, Admin-only actions return 403 for Editors); race conditions in the status transitions; and the published_at migration. Report findings only, do not change any files."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"f6738f29-00fe-4d46-b82a-19af7e71d4bd","timestamp":"2026-10-24T16:17:41.604Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9befb7af-ec4f-43a4-8458-1d6db544bfb9","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: the uncommitted T04 changes. Focus on: any way to get script, event-handler attributes, javascript: or data: URLs, external links or images through render_body or Preview; CSRF on every new POST route (submit, send-back, publish, unpublish, both Preview routes); access control on each new route (Editors only on their own Drafts, Admin-only actions return 403 for Editors); race conditions in the status transitions; and the published_at migration. Report findings only, do not change any files."}]}}

The report follows:\n  STANDARDS REVIEW (read-only; nothing in the repo or cms.db was modified)\n  \n  HARD VIOLATIONS (documented standards)\n  - None found. Every hard constraint I checked holds, with two small notes under judgement calls (the dropped `Depends(require(...))` convention on submit, and a `route -> status` rule in the docstring).\n  \n  SECURITY\n  \n  (1) Markdown and Preview. I found no bypass. I ran about 35 hostile inputs through `render_body` (app/markdown.py:62-89), including:\n  - entity-encoded `&#106;avascript:`, `&#x09;` inside a scheme, tab, control character and NBSP before a scheme, and `%6A` percent-encoding;\n  - `//host`, `\\\\host`, `data:`, `mailto:`, and `<javascript:...>` as an autolink;\n  - reference-style `[1]: javascript:`;\n  - link titles with injected attributes, and `<script>` inside image alt text;\n  - `<svg onload>`, `<math>` with an xlink:href, nested `<scr<script>ipt>`, unclosed `<script>`, `<style>`, and an `<iframe>` after a comment;\n  - raw `<img onerror>` in a list item, `<b onclick>` in a blockquote, and `<script>` in a table cell.\n  \n  Results:\n  - No tags outside the allowlist, no event attributes, and no external links or images came through.\n  - The only surviving hrefs were relative (`#frag`, `?q=1`, `./a:b`, `%5Cevil.com`, `%6Aavascript:...`). Browsers don't decode percent-escapes in a scheme, and `%5C` is a relative path, so all of these are inert.\n  - Every image is dropped, since `image_urls` is empty.\n  - `preview_html | safe` (templates/admin/recap_form.html, the new `<section id=\"preview\">`) is fed only by `render_body(body)` at app/routes/recaps.py:219 and :233. No other caller uses `| safe`.\n  - Flash messages render with `{{ message }}`, which Jinja autoescapes. The messages are constants.\n  \n  Judgement note: the `is_relative()` check (markdown.py:30-35) strips whitespace and control characters. That is correct, and nh3's `url_schemes=set()` backs it up.\n  \n  (2) CSRF. Covered.\n  - app/main.py builds `FastAPI(dependencies=[Depends(csrf_protect)])`, which applies to every route.\n  - `csrf_protect` (app/security.py) checks all non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS methods.\n  - That covers submit, send-back, publish, unpublish and both preview routes.\n  - The status-button forms in recap_form.html carry `csrf_token`.\n  - The Preview button is `formaction` on the main form, which already has the token (not shown in the diff, so inferred).\n  - I did not check the main form's token line directly.\n  \n  JUDGEMENT CALLS (documented-standard flavour)\n  - app/routes/recaps.py:171, submit route: it uses `require(\"console.view\")`, while the other three use their own action, e.g. `require(\"recaps.send_back\")`. `_move` then does the real `recaps.submit` check. This is the same pattern `delete_recap` already uses, and the policy.py docstring is still satisfied. It is inconsistent within the diff, not a breach.\n  - app/policy.py:35 and :44-46: `OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS` duplicates the owner-and-draft condition that `RECAP_ACTIONS` already encodes. The two branches have the same body, so a single set or helper would do. This is Duplicated Code.\n  - CONTEXT.md vocabulary is respected (Submit, Send back, Publish/Unpublish, Deploy). I found no vocabulary violations.\n  \n  BASELINE SMELLS (judgement calls)\n  - Repeated Switches / Shotgun Surgery: the status-action names are keyed in four places: `STATUS_ACTIONS` (routes), `TRANSITIONS` and `PUBLISHED_AT_SQL` (recaps.py), and the `ROLE_RULES` entries. `_move` also special-cases `action == \"submit\"` and `action == \"unpublish\"` by string. Adding a status action means editing about five places. A single table or small object per action would fix it.\n  - Primitive Obsession: the action is a bare string such as `\"send-back\"` passed through `_move(request, recap_id, account, \"send-back\", \"recaps.send_back\")`. The URL name and policy action are passed together every time. This is also a Data Clump.\n  - Data Clumps (routes/recaps.py:210-258): the six form fields `trip_id, title, slug, body, byline_name, byline_class_year` are repeated in `_form_values`, both preview signatures, and the existing create/edit routes. The existing code already builds the same dict inline at :259-260, so `_form_values` is not reused. Duplicated Code.\n  - Duplicated Code: `preview_new_recap` and `preview_recap` are near-identical.\n  - Mysterious Name: `_move` (it performs a status transition), `marks` and `stamp` in `recaps.transition`, and `keep` in `render_body`.\n  - Speculative Generality: the `image_urls` parameter on `render_body` and the `ROLE_RULES` entry `recaps.unpublish`, which is the same as `publish`. The docstring says no images exist yet. The `image_urls` machinery is defensible if images are coming in a later ticket.\n  - Feature Envy (mild): `_available_actions` in the route layer reads `recaps.TRANSITIONS`. The status-machine knowledge belongs in recaps.py.\n  - Middle Man (mild): the four route functions only delegate to `_move`.\n  - Divergent Change: routes/recaps.py now holds CRUD, the status machine and Preview.\n</agent-message>"}

No hard spec failures. One real gap (focus 4), the rest minor.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial**\n  - Focus 4, edit race. Spec: \"Once their Recap is Submitted or Published, an Editor can no longer edit or delete it.\" `app/recaps.py:24-39` `update_recap` and `delete_recap` (`:67-69`) have no status or owner guard in the SQL. The route reads the row, checks the policy (`app/routes/recaps.py:~270`), then updates. An Editor's edit that passed the check while still Draft can land after Submit or Publish, so what the Admin reviewed changes under them (story 12). `transition` itself is atomic; the edit and delete paths are not. Fix: add `AND status='draft' AND owner_id=?` for Editors, and check `rowcount`.\n  - Focus 4, empty-Body check. Spec: \"Submitting with an empty Body is refused.\" The check (`_move`, `routes/recaps.py:~164`) reads the stale row, not the UPDATE. `_save` refuses an empty Body, so an empty Body only arises from pre-existing rows. Low risk, but not atomic.\n  - Notice scope. The spec says \"Recap or Page\" (story 30). Pages don't exist yet, so this is not a defect.\n  \n  **(b) Scope creep**\n  - `app/recaps.py:~92`: Unpublish sets `published_at = NULL`. The spec doesn't ask for this. It's defensible, but the timestamp is lost, and story 56 orders by \"order they were Published\".\n  - `is_relative` also rejects `#frag` and `?q`? No: it keeps them. It rejects only schemes and a leading `/`, which is consistent with the spec.\n  \n  **(c) Implemented but questionable**\n  - Focus 1, sanitizer. I probed 34 hostile inputs against `app/markdown.render_body`.\n    - Script, `<svg>`, `<iframe>`, `<style>`, onerror/onclick and comments are all removed.\n    - Entity-encoded, mixed-case, tab-split, `\\x01`, `&Tab;`, `data:` and `vbscript:` schemes never become `<a>`. markdown-it leaves them as text.\n    - `//evil` and `/abs` are unlinked with the text kept. `mailto:` is unlinked with the text kept. A backslash target is emitted as `%5Cevil.com`, a harmless relative link.\n    - Autolinks (`<http://…>`) become plain text. Reference-style `javascript:` is not linked.\n    - External images are removed. Only `image_urls` members survive (verified: `images/a.jpg` passes when supplied).\n    - No bypass found.\n    - Two quirks. `title` survives on `<a>` and `<img>` (ammonia's generic attributes), contradicting `ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES` at `app/markdown.py:18`. It is escaped plain text, so it is harmless. A removed image leaves an empty `<p></p>`.\n    - A raw block such as `<script>…</script>hi` drops the trailing `hi` on the same line. That is consistent with the docstring.\n    - Both Preview routes call `render_body(body)` with no `image_urls` (`routes/recaps.py:~212 and ~226`). That is correct until T06, but those two call sites must pass the Recap's Images then.\n    - The template uses `| safe` on the sanitized output only.\n  - Focus 2, CSRF. `csrf_protect` is an app-wide dependency (`app/main.py:29`), so all six new POST routes are covered. Probed: all return 403 without a token. Status-action forms and the Preview `formaction` button (inside the token-bearing form, `recap_form.html:27`) both carry the token.\n  - Focus 3, access control.\n    - Publish, Unpublish and Send back use `require(action)`, so an Editor gets 403 before the lookup, including for nonexistent ids.\n    - Submit goes through `_allowed_recap` with the owner-and-draft policy. An Admin gets 403. A nonexistent id gets 404 for any role.\n    - Previewing someone else's or a locked Recap goes through `recaps.edit` and gives 403.\n    - Route order is fine: `/preview` is declared before `/{recap_id}`, and `/{recap_id}/preview` is a distinct path.\n    - Caveat, not new: a logged-out POST without a token gets 403, not a login redirect, because CSRF runs first. A logged-out POST with a token does redirect.\n  - Focus 5, migration. I ran it on a pre-T04 DB: the column was added, and a second run was a no-op. Existing rows are kept (nullable column). Race: two processes starting at once can both pass the PRAGMA check, and the loser raises `OperationalError: duplicate column name`. It should be caught. `app/main.py:45` runs `create_app()` at import, so any import runs `init_db` against the configured DB.\n  - Focus 6, flash.\n    - Flashes live in the signed session cookie. `SessionMiddleware` always sets the cookie, so a cookieless client just gets a fresh session. It is not encrypted, but it holds only fixed notice text.\n    - `_header.html` renders `{{ message }}` autoescaped. Both flash sources are server constants.\n    - The redirect target is always `/admin/recaps`, an admin page that includes the header. A flash is popped by any admin page that renders the header first, so a non-header page would leave it queued.\n    - The 400 error path doesn't flash (correct). The flash fires on Unpublish and on a successful edit of a Published Recap.\n</agent-message>"}

{"parentUuid":"993ab2a9-67e5-4287-a287-7f21ae7cbbe1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMNEPw7NtCjefGZDKbkd","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Both reviews are in. Neither found a way through the sanitizer, a CSRF gap, or an access-control gap. The Spec reviewer found one real race in Editor edits. I changed no files, and I haven't reproduced the race and migration findings myself.\n\n## Standards\n**Hard violations: none.** The reviewer found every repo constraint in `CLAUDE.md` and `SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md` satisfied.\n\n**Judgement calls**\n- **Duplicated policy branch:** `OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS` in `app/policy.py:35` and `:44-46` repeats the owner-and-Draft check that `RECAP_ACTIONS` already encodes.\n- **Inconsistent route guard:** the submit route uses `require(\"console.view\")` while the other three use their own action (`app/routes/recaps.py:171`). It matches the existing delete route, and the real check is in `_move`.\n- **Status actions keyed in about five places:** `STATUS_ACTIONS`, `TRANSITIONS`, `PUBLISHED_AT_SQL`, `ROLE_RULES`, and string checks for `\"submit\"` and `\"unpublish\"` inside `_move`. The action is also passed around as a bare string with its policy action.\n- **Repeated form fields:** the same six fields appear in `_form_values`, both preview routes, and the old create and edit routes. `_form_values` isn't reused by the old routes, and the two preview routes are near-identical.\n- **Naming:** `_move`, `marks`, `stamp` and `keep` are vague names.\n- **Smaller points:**\n  - `_available_actions` in the route layer reads the status table from `recaps.py`.\n  - `image_urls` and the separate `recaps.unpublish` rule are ahead of need. `image_urls` is expected to be used in T06.\n  - `routes/recaps.py` now holds CRUD, status changes and Preview.\n\n## Spec\n**Real gap: Editor edits are not guarded against a concurrent Submit or Publish.** `update_recap` (`app/recaps.py:24-39`) and `delete_recap` (`:67-69`) have no status or owner condition in their SQL. The route checks the policy and then updates in a separate step. An Editor's save that passed the check while the Recap was a Draft can land after an Admin has Published it. That breaks \"Once their Recap is Submitted or Published, an Editor can no longer edit or delete it\" (story 12). `transition` itself is atomic. The reviewer's fix is to add `AND status='draft' AND owner_id=?` for Editors and check `rowcount`.\n\n**Smaller findings**\n- **Empty-Body check:** it reads the row the route fetched earlier, not the row being updated. `_save` already refuses empty Bodies, so the risk is low.\n- **Migration race:** two processes starting at once can both pass the column check, and the loser raises `duplicate column name`. It should be caught. The reviewer also notes that importing `app.main` runs `init_db` against the configured database.\n- **Unpublish clears `published_at`:** the reviewer flagged this as beyond the spec, and it affects story 56's \"order they were Published\". Also, both Preview calls must pass the Recap's Images once T06 lands.\n- **Flash:** it's autoescaped and uses fixed text. It only clears when an admin page renders the header, which holds today because it always redirects to `/admin/recaps`.\n- **Pages:** the \"still live\" notice for Pages (story 30) waits on the Pages ticket.\n\n**Verified clean**\n- **Sanitizer:** about 35 hostile inputs from each reviewer. They covered entity-encoded and mixed-case schemes, `data:`, `vbscript:`, `//` and backslash targets, `svg`/`math`/`iframe`, and nested or unclosed `<script>`. Nothing got through.\n- **CSRF:** all six new POST routes return 403 without a token, and every form carries one.\n- **Access control:** Editors get 403 on Publish, Unpublish and Send back even for ids that don't exist, an Admin Submit is refused, and the `/preview` route order is correct.\n\n**Summary:** Standards has 0 hard violations and about 9 judgement calls. The worst is the status-action wiring spread over about five places. Spec has 1 real gap (the unguarded Editor edit and delete) plus 3 minor findings. I changed nothing. Tell me which of these to fix. {"parentUuid":"a3f5ad07-dc75-4e77-8c8a-db053b48d615","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMNTy81YdTZSYKvsEE7Q","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_016w8JP8TQTHSkhQ18x7nMgA","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrewv-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/9befb7af-ec4f-43a4-8458-1d6db544bfb9/scratchpad/comment.md <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` of the T04 changes (uncommitted, against `d3ebd6a`)\n\nTwo reviews ran separately: Standards (repo rules plus a code-smell baseline) and Spec (issue #5 and spec #1). Focus areas: sanitizer, CSRF, access control, status-transition races, the `published_at` migration.\n\n### Found, and clean\n- **Sanitizer (`render_body`, Preview):** about 35 hostile inputs per reviewer. They covered entity-encoded, mixed-case and tab-split schemes, `data:`, `vbscript:`, `javascript:`, `//` and backslash targets, `svg`/`math`/`iframe`, nested and unclosed `<script>`, and event handlers. Nothing got through. `| safe` is applied only to `render_body` output.\n- **CSRF:** all six new POST routes return 403 without a token, and every action form and the Preview button carry one.\n- **Access control:** Publish, Unpublish and Send back return 403 for Editors, including for ids that don't exist. Only the owning Editor can Submit. Previewing another person's Recap or a locked one returns 403. `/preview` is declared before `/{recap_id}`.\n\n### Found, and fixed\n1. **Editor edit/delete race (real gap).** `update_recap` and `delete_recap` had no status or owner condition in their SQL. An Editor's save that passed the policy check while the Recap was a Draft could land after it was Submitted or Published, which breaks \"Once their Recap is Submitted or Published, an Editor can no longer edit or delete it\". Four failing tests (edit and delete, Submitted and Published) reproduced it first; they simulate the window by giving the route a stale Draft row. The Editor path now adds `AND status = 'draft' AND owner_id = ?` to the UPDATE and the DELETE, checks the row count, and refuses with 409 when no row changed. Admin behavior is unchanged.\n2. **Migration race.** Two processes starting at once could both pass the `PRAGMA` check, and the loser would crash with `duplicate column name`. `init_db` now catches that one error and re-raises anything else. No test, by decision.\n\n### Deferred as known debt\n- Policy duplication: `OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS` repeats the owner-and-Draft check in `RECAP_ACTIONS`.\n- Status-action wiring in about five places (`STATUS_ACTIONS`, `TRANSITIONS`, `PUBLISHED_AT_SQL`, `ROLE_RULES`, string checks in `_move`).\n- Repeated form fields across the create, edit and two preview routes, and the near-duplicate preview routes.\n- Naming: `_move`, `marks`, `stamp`, `keep`.\n\n### Also noted, not addressed in this ticket\n- The empty-Body check on Submit reads the row fetched earlier in the request, not the row being updated. `_save` already refuses empty Bodies, so it only matters for rows that predate it.\n- Both Preview routes call `render_body(body)` with no `image_urls`. That is correct until T06, when they must pass the Recap's Images.\n- `title` survives on `<a>` and `<img>` (nh3's generic attributes). It is escaped plain text, so harmless.\n- The \"still live until you Deploy\" notice for Pages (story 30) waits on the Pages ticket.\n\n### Rebutted, by decision\n- **Unpublish clears `published_at`.** The Spec reviewer called it beyond the spec, since story 56 orders Recaps by when they were Published. It stays: a Draft should not carry a Published timestamp, and Publishing again stamps a new one.\n\nFull suite: 254 passed (193 existing plus 61 new).\nEOF\ngh issue comment 5 --body-file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrewv-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/9befb7af-ec4f-43a4-8458-1d6db544bfb9/scratchpad/comment.md 2>&1; git status --short | grep -v \"transcripts\\|notes/\"","description":"Post review comment on issue 5; scope check"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1463,"cache_read_input_tokens":158101,"output_tokens":1895,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":289},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1463,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1895,"cache_read_input_tokens":158101,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1463,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1463},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_016w8JP8TQTHSkhQ18x7nMgA":{"command":"cd /Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrewv-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/9befb7af-ec4f-43a4-8458-1d6db544bfb9/scratchpad/comment.md <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` of the T04 changes (uncommitted, against `d3ebd6a`)\n\nTwo reviews ran separately: Standards (repo rules plus a code-smell baseline) and Spec (issue #5 and spec #1). Previewing another person's Recap or a locked one returns 403. `/preview` is declared before `/{recap_id}`.\n\n### Found, and fixed\n1. **Editor edit/delete race (real gap).** `update_recap` and `delete_recap` had no status or owner condition in their SQL. An Editor's save that passed the policy check while the Recap was a Draft could land after it was Submitted or Published, which breaks \"Once their Recap is Submitted or Published, an Editor can no longer edit or delete it\". Four failing tests (edit and delete, Submitted and Published) reproduced it first; they simulate the window by giving the route a stale Draft row. The Editor path now adds `AND status = 'draft' AND owner_id = ?` to the UPDATE and the DELETE, checks the row count, and refuses with 409 when no row changed. Admin behavior is unchanged.\n2. **Migration race.** Two processes starting at once could both pass the `PRAGMA` check, and the loser would crash with `duplicate column name`. `init_db` now catches that one error and re-raises anything else. No test, by decision.\n\n### Deferred as known debt\n- Policy duplication: `OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS` repeats the owner-and-Draft check in `RECAP_ACTIONS`.\n- Status-action wiring in about five places (`STATUS_ACTIONS`, `TRANSITIONS`, `PUBLISHED_AT_SQL`, `ROLE_RULES`, string checks in `_move`).\n- Repeated form fields across the create, edit and two preview routes, and the near-duplicate preview routes.\n- Naming: `_move`, `marks`, `stamp`, `keep`.\n\n### Also noted, not addressed in this ticket\n- The empty-Body check on Submit reads the row fetched earlier in the request, not the row being updated. `_save` already refuses empty Bodies, so it only matters for rows that predate it.\n- Both Preview routes call `render_body(body)` with no `image_urls`. That is correct until T06, when they must pass the Recap's Images.\n- `title` survives on `<a>` and `<img>` (nh3's generic attributes). It is escaped plain text, so harmless.\n- The \"still live until you Deploy\" notice for Pages (story 30) waits on the Pages ticket.\n\n### Rebutted, by decision\n- **Unpublish clears `published_at`.** The Spec reviewer called it beyond the spec, since story 56 orders Recaps by when they were Published. It stays: a Draft should not carry a Published timestamp, and Publishing again stamps a new one.\n\nFull suite: 254 passed (193 existing plus 61 new).\nEOF\ngh issue comment 5 --body-file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrewv-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/9befb7af-ec4f-43a4-8458-1d6db544bfb9/scratchpad/comment.md 2>&1; git status --short | grep -v \"transcripts\\|notes/\"","description":"Post review comment on issue 5; scope check"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}
